howToPlay: Use your range to apply pressure while keeping your distance. Deploy your Super strategically to support your team, and use your Gadgets to either reposition instantly or maximize your burst damage output.
gears: Equip DAMAGE and RELOAD SPEED to capitalize on your high offensive potential. Use SHIELD or HEALTH to compensate for your slow movement speed and increase your survivability.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer a calculated, stationary playstyle focused on area control and team support.
